subject: Perspectives in Education
stem: For learners who cannot attend regular schools (due to work, distance, or other constraints), this autonomous organisation under the Ministry of Education provides open and distance learning at the secondary and senior secondary levels, along with vocational and life-enrichment courses. It is the:
explanation: NIOS provides flexible, open schooling for learners unable to access the regular formal system — distinct from NCERT (curriculum/textbook development), NCTE (teacher-education regulation), or the UGC (higher-education/university regulation).
